WITH d1 AS (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy = 4 AND d_year = 1999),
d2 AS (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999)),
d3 AS (SELECT * FROM date_dim WHERE d_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d_year = 1999))
SELECT i_item_id,i_item_desc,s_store_id,s_store_name,MAX(ss_net_profit) as store_sales_profit,MAX(sr_net_loss) as store_returns_loss,MAX(cs_net_profit) as catalog_sales_profit 
FROM d1 JOIN store_sales ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND i_item_sk = ss_item_sk AND s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
JOIN item ON i_item_sk = ss_item_sk 
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk 
JOIN store_returns ON sr_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND sr_item_sk = ss_item_sk
JOIN catalog_sales ON cs_bill_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk AND cs_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk 
GROUP BY i_item_id,i_item_desc,s_store_id,s_store_name ORDER BY i_item_id,i_item_desc,s_store_id,s_store_name LIMIT 100
